subject.title: feat(models): add provider request.timeoutMs and retry configuration

question: Should this PR expose a provider-level retry config now, remove retry and land only the timeoutMs work, or wait for the canonical main-LLM retry/backoff design?
rationale: The retry half adds public config surface and fallback expectations, which automation cannot choose safely without maintainer API/product direction.

options.title: Split retry out
options.body: Remove the retry schema/help/label/type additions from this PR and review a focused, proven `request.timeoutMs` patch while keeping retry on the canonical tracker.

options.title: Implement retry fully
options.body: Wire retry into model calls with retryable error classification, fallback ordering, docs/baseline updates, upgrade behavior, and runtime tests before exposing the field.

options.title: Pause for canonical design
options.body: Leave or close this PR until maintainers settle the public retry/backoff contract on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/49376.

recommendation.title: Split retry out
recommendation.body: Remove the retry schema/help/label/type additions from this PR and review a focused, proven `request.timeoutMs` patch while keeping retry on the canonical tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: The product choice centers on provider retry/failover behavior, and current history plus the canonical tracker point most strongly to this owner.
